observed_behavior: GOV.UK design guidance assigns default buttons to the main call to action and cautions against multiple defaults on a page because more than one main call to action can obscure the next step.
context: W02 action-controls pilot; documented design-system behavior, not universal recommendation
limitations: Recommendation within GOV.UK service conventions, not WCAG or measured performance in this run.
notes: Source documentation inspected; no independent end-user usability testing
